evidence.summary: The production /login page (apps/web/src/app/login/page.tsx:115-117) unconditionally renders a caption reading 'Dev seed (after IAM migration): admin@local / changeme', with no environment gate. This is the exact page exposed through the public pilot tunnel, and it discloses a real admin username plus a guessable default password pattern to any anonymous visitor. Not caused by N-0033's own commits, but discovered live during this review and directly undermines the node's own 'safe enough for a small temporary pilot' claim.
